# Crates

Generated by `harness-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 11 packages. None is on a registry; build them from the repository. The crates they depend on live in their own repositories, each pinned by tag or revision: the tool, model-client and MCP crates in the workspace `Cargo.toml`, the confinement crates in `crates/harness-substrate/Cargo.toml` and the specification crates in `crates/harness-conformance/Cargo.toml`.

| Package | Directory | In Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `b10x-harness-app-server` | [`crates/harness-app-server`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-app-server) | `use b10x_harness_app_server` | Serves the b10x loop over the pinned Codex app-server JSON-RPC format |
| `b10x-harness-catalogue` | [`crates/harness-catalogue`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-catalogue) | `use harness_catalogue` | One catalogue of tools, published to every harness under three verbs, over the tools crates' operations |
| `b10x-harness-cli` | [`crates/harness-cli`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-cli) | `use b10x_harness_cli`, binary `b10x-harness` | The b10x harness, driven from the command line |
| `b10x-harness-conformance` | [`crates/harness-conformance`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-conformance) | binary `b10x-harness-conformance` | ESS conformance against native Harness library boundaries |
| `b10x-harness-llm` | [`crates/harness-llm`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-llm) | `use harness_llm` | The b10x harness's model port over llm's client crates, and the credential sources that feed them |
| `b10x-harness-loop` | [`crates/harness-loop`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-loop) | `use b10x_harness_loop` | The b10x agent loop: turn assembly, tool round trips, approvals and budgets |
| `b10x-harness-mcp` | [`crates/harness-mcp`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-mcp) | `use b10x_harness_mcp` | Reviewed MCP tool snapshots as a Harness ToolPort |
| `b10x-harness-substrate` | [`crates/harness-substrate`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-substrate) | `use b10x_harness_substrate` | A client of the substrate wire: what this machine can confine, and the tools that answer |
| `b10x-harness-wire` | [`crates/harness-wire`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-wire) | `use b10x_harness_wire` | Neutral values and ports shared by the b10x agent loop and its model wires |
| `b10x-harness-xtask` | [`crates/harness-xtask`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-xtask) | binary `b10x-harness-xtask` | The repository's own gate and contract checkers, run as cargo xtask |
| `harness-docs` | [`crates/harness-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/harness/tree/main/crates/harness-docs) | `use harness_docs`, binary `harness-docs` | Generates the derived pages of the Harness documentation site (CLI, toolchains, crates, status), checks every page, and binds a built site to its commit |
